690bcb580b8f9c461c3eae53 description:
Hello, mercenary! Mechanic trusts you, and so will I. Did you know there is a USEC special operations division? Recently, they've been becoming somewhat present in Tarkov with small operations. 

I've heard rumors that they are working to end this conflict once and for all, and I can't wait for it to be over. So, I've been tracking some footsteps, and they led me to Factory. 

I learned that during a mission in Factory, they were heavily pressured by Scavs and left behind a folder with important documents. I want you to go there, find this folder, and bring it to me. 

Good luck!
690bcb580b8f9c461c3eae53 successMessageT: Good job! With these documents, we can advance our plans.
690bcc71a1b6372307006136: Find the TerraGroup document folder in the Factory office

690d8ad1750d535b2e9bc135 description:
Hello again, mercenary! It's great to see you're still in one piece. The information in the folder you brought contains data from a TerraGroup investigation, along with USEC, about a secret task force that was interfering with both their operations. A third enemy, or do they have no idea about their own internal resources? 

Either way, the information also says that a document with the possible contacts of the members of this task force was forgotten in the Lighthouse chalet, perhaps that is what those soldiers didn't want us to discover. 

Go there, find the diary, and bring it to me. We need to know who we are dealing with.
690d8c27dc1e0cb5c27bf5be: Locate the Diary with Contact Information in the Lighthouse chalet.
690d8ad1750d535b2e9bc135 successMessageT: Good job! With this, we can establish contact.
690d8ad1750d535b2e9bc135 failMessageText: You handed this over to Fence!? He's part of a Scav legion; do you want to end this or create an even bigger conflict?
690bb986148ac0cfb2669d32 description:
The diary wasn't necessary in the end. I hate having my peace disturbed, but messing with these guys did exactly that. A woman and some soldiers found me and came to talk to me. The woman specifically was impressed with all our effort to establish contact and agreed to talk to us. 

Her name is Aishi, and I feel something strange; it's better to be careful, so keep your eyes open. 

Good luck, mercenary!
690bb986148ac0cfb2669d32 successMessageT: Great! Don't forget to be careful.
